why: issue 1975 — a read of the arena's own `TimerHeader::clock_source`, the field `arena::timer_try_process` reads, exposed so `nros-cpp`'s `Timer::get_clock` (`cpp:Timer::get_clock`) forwards rather than keeping a second copy of the clock beside the registration. Sits on the executor for the reason its `timer_is_ready` / `timer_elapsed_us` siblings do: RFC-0002's arena owns timer state, so there is no owning `Timer` object to hang it on.
